css.name: CSS
css.description: Learn styling step by step: selectors, properties, layouts and complete practice projects.

lessons.title: What is CSS?
lessons.summary: CSS HTML ki appearance badalta hai: colors, fonts, spacing aur layout. Pehle element select karein, phir property aur value likhein.
lessons.remember: HTML content banata hai; CSS uska look aur layout set karta hai.
lessons.practice: Ek heading ka color aur paragraph ka font-size badal kar output dekhein.

children.text: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is the language we use to style web pages. It's the artistic palette that brings HTML to life, controlling layout, colors, fonts, spacing, and more.
Define colors, fonts, and visual appearance of elements
Control positioning and arrangement of elements
Create layouts that adapt to different screen sizes

lessons.title: Evolution of CSS
lessons.summary: CSS ka development levels aur modules mein hua. Aaj alag CSS features alag specifications mein develop hote hain.
lessons.remember: CSS3 ek single release ya ek saal ka complete package nahi hai.
lessons.practice: CSS1, CSS2 aur modern modular CSS ka short timeline banayein.

children.text: Håkon Wium Lie proposes CSS while working at CERN alongside HTML creator Tim Berners-Lee
CSS Level 1 becomes a W3C Recommendation, introducing basic styling capabilities
CSS Level 2 adds positioning, z-index, media types, and bidirectional text
Modern CSS is developed as separate modules, including animations, flexbox and grid; they did not all arrive in one release.

lessons.title: Characteristics of CSS
lessons.summary: CSS HTML ki appearance badalta hai: colors, fonts, spacing aur layout. Pehle element select karein, phir property aur value likhein.
lessons.remember: HTML content banata hai; CSS uska look aur layout set karta hai.
lessons.practice: Ek heading ka color aur paragraph ka font-size badal kar output dekhein.

children.text: : CSS allows you to apply styles to multiple HTML elements at once, saving time and effort compared to inline styles.
: CSS provides more advanced styling options, such as layout control, typography, and animations, which are not easily achievable with HTML alone.
: CSS files can be cached by the browser, allowing for faster page loading and offline browsing.
: CSS separates the presentation from the content, making it easier to maintain and update the website's appearance.

lessons.remember: External stylesheet ka path sahi hona chahiye. Missing file se styling load nahi hogi.
lessons.practice: Ek hi paragraph ko inline, internal aur external CSS se style karein.

lessons.title: Priorities of CSS
lessons.summary: Same element par multiple rules lagen to cascade decide karta hai kaunsa rule apply hoga. Same origin, importance aur layer mein ID ki specificity class se zyada hoti hai.
lessons.remember: !important selector specificity nahi hai. Origin, importance aur layers bhi matter karte hain; equal specificity mein later rule jeetta hai.
lessons.practice: Ek paragraph ko class aur ID se alag colors dein; phir rule order badal kar dekhein.

lessons.summary: CSS HTML ki appearance badalta hai: colors, fonts, spacing aur layout. Pehle element select karein, phir property aur value likhein.
lessons.remember: HTML content banata hai; CSS uska look aur layout set karta hai.
lessons.practice: Ek heading ka color aur paragraph ka font-size badal kar output dekhein.

children.text: The basic CSS syntax consists of three parts:
The HTML element or elements you want to style.
The specific style attribute you want to change.
The new value you want to apply to the property.

lessons.title: CSS Selectors
lessons.summary: Selector batata hai style kin elements par lagega. Element, class, ID, attribute aur combinators ko ek-ek karke practice karein.
lessons.remember: div p sab descendant paragraphs select karta hai; div > p sirf direct children.
lessons.practice: Ek list mein sirf even items ko :nth-child(even) se style karein.

Targets a unique element based on its ID attribute.
Targets elements based on their class attribute.
Targets elements based on their attribute values.
Targets elements with a specific attribute value.

Targets direct children of a specified element.

Targets all siblings of an element that follow it.

lessons.title: 1. Border Properties
lessons.summary: Border element ke aas-paas ki line hai. Width, style aur color set karein; border-radius se corners round hote hain.
lessons.remember: border: 2px solid blue mein width, style aur color teen parts hain.
lessons.practice: Solid, dashed, dotted aur rounded border ke chaar boxes banayein.

children.text: Border properties in CSS allow you to create and style borders around HTML elements. They are essential for defining the visual boundaries and enhancing the design of web pages. Borders can be customized in terms of style, width, color, and shape.
Key aspects of border properties include:
The border-style property specifies the type of border to display.
border-style: none | hidden | dotted | dashed | solid | double | groove | ridge | inset | outset |
The border-width defines the thickness of the border.
The border-color sets the color of the border.
Target specific sides of the border.

children.code:
border-top: 5px dashed red;

border-bottom: 5px dotted blue;

children.text: Combine width, style, and color in one declaration.

examples:
border-top: 5px dashed red;

border-bottom: 5px dotted blue;

lessons.title: 2. Display Property
lessons.summary: Block nayi line leta hai; inline text ke flow mein rehta hai; inline-block inline rehte hue width aur height allow karta hai.
lessons.remember: display:none layout se bhi element hata deta hai; visibility:hidden jagah preserve karta hai.
lessons.practice: Teen links ko block, inline aur inline-block se compare karein.

children.text: The `display` property in CSS determines how an element is displayed in the document. It influences the layout and interaction of an element with surrounding elements. Common values are:
: The element takes up the entire width of its parent, creating a new line.
: The element does not start on a new line, and its width/height cannot be manually adjusted.
: Similar to inline, but allows setting width and height.
Takes full width of parent container
Always starts on a new line
Flows within text, no line breaks

lessons.title: 4. Display: Flex 🔧
lessons.summary: Block nayi line leta hai; inline text ke flow mein rehta hai; inline-block inline rehte hue width aur height allow karta hai.
lessons.remember: display:none layout se bhi element hata deta hai; visibility:hidden jagah preserve karta hai.
lessons.practice: Teen links ko block, inline aur inline-block se compare karein.

children.text: It creates a flexible layout system for arranging items in a container.
It helps align and distribute items easily, even when their sizes vary.

lessons.title: 3. CSS Box Model: Comprehensive Guide
lessons.summary: Har box content, padding, border aur margin se milkar banta hai. Padding andar aur margin bahar ki spacing hai.
lessons.remember: content-box mein width ke alawa padding aur border add hote hain.
lessons.practice: Width 200px, padding 20px aur border 2px ke box ki actual width calculate karein.

lessons.title: 1. Box Shadow 🌓
lessons.summary: box-shadow element ke bahar ya andar shadow banata hai. Offset, blur, spread aur color ko alag-alag samjhein.
lessons.remember: Shadow layout space ko increase nahi karta.
lessons.practice: Ek card par soft shadow aur hover shadow banayein.

children.text: It adds a shadow to an element, making it look like it's lifted off the page.
It gives depth and a polished look to elements.

lessons.title: 2. Box Sizing 📦
lessons.summary: box-sizing:border-box mein declared width ke andar padding aur border count hote hain.
lessons.remember: Margin border-box width ka hissa nahi hai.
lessons.practice: Same width ke content-box aur border-box elements compare karein.

children.text: It decides how the size of an element is calculated (whether padding and border are included or excluded).
It simplifies layout and ensures consistent element sizes.
Includes padding and border in total width

lessons.title: 3. Box Decoration Break 🎨
lessons.summary: box-decoration-break batata hai line ya column mein tootne wale box ka background aur border kaise paint hoga.
lessons.remember: clone aur slice ko wrapping inline text ke saath compare karein.
lessons.practice: Ek long highlighted sentence ko do lines mein wrap karein.

children.text: Controls how decorations like borders, backgrounds, and shadows behave when content breaks into multiple lines or boxes.
Ensures a smooth or continuous look for elements split across lines.

lessons.title: 4. List Styles

children.text: Defines the appearance of list markers. Can change bullets to different shapes or numbers to various numbering systems.

lessons.title: CSS Position Properties
lessons.summary: Static, relative, absolute, fixed aur sticky se positioning badalti hai. Absolute element aam taur par nearest positioned ancestor ke relative hota hai.
lessons.remember: Sticky ko inset, jaise top:0, aur suitable scroll space chahiye.
lessons.practice: Ek relative card ke top-right mein absolute badge rakhein.

children.text: The CSS position property defines how an element is positioned in a document. It can change an element's layout behavior and its relationship to other elements.
Default positioning. Element follows normal document flow.

children.code:
position: static;
/* Default behavior, no special positioning */

children.text: Positioned relative to its normal position. Doesn't affect other elements.
Removed from normal document flow. Positioned relative to nearest positioned ancestor.
Positioned relative to the browser window. Stays in the same place during scrolling.
Toggles between relative and fixed positioning based on scroll position.

children.code:
position: sticky;
top: 0;  /* Sticks to top when scrolled */

children.text: The positioning of elements depends on their context:
Static and relative positioned elements remain within the normal document flow.
Absolute positioned elements are taken out of the flow and positioned relative to their nearest positioned ancestor.
Fixed and sticky elements are positioned relative to the browser viewport.

examples:
position: static;
/* Default behavior, no special positioning */

position: sticky;
top: 0;  /* Sticks to top when scrolled */

quiz.question: Which HTML tag is used to define an internal style sheet?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which HTML tag is used to define an internal style sheet?
quiz.explanation: The <style> element contains an internal stylesheet in the HTML document.

quiz.question: Which option is a ready-made framework often used to create responsive websites?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which of the following is used to make a website responsive?
quiz.explanation: Bootstrap provides ready-made responsive layout components. Plain CSS can also create responsive layouts.

quiz.question: Which dedicated CSS longhand property changes the background colour?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which property is used in CSS to change the background color?
quiz.explanation: background-color sets just the background colour; background is a shorthand for several background properties.

quiz.question: Which of the following is not a valid CSS property?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which of the following is not a valid CSS property?
quiz.explanation: table-align is not a CSS property. Use text-align for cell text and margin/layout rules to position a table.

quiz.question: Which CSS framework is known for its grid system?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which CSS framework is known for its grid system?
quiz.explanation: These frameworks provide utilities or components for grid-based layouts.

quiz.question: Which property is used to set the spacing between lines of text?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which property is used to set the spacing between lines of text?
quiz.explanation: line-height controls line box height. letter-spacing controls the gap between characters.

quiz.question: Which CSS property is used to control the stacking order of elements?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which CSS property is used to control the stacking order of elements?
quiz.explanation: z-index affects stacking order, subject to stacking contexts and the applicable layout/positioning rules.

quiz.question: Which option is not a valid value of the CSS position property?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which of the following is not a valid CSS position property?
quiz.explanation: float is a separate CSS property, not a value of position. Valid position values include static, relative, absolute, fixed and sticky.

quiz.question: Which CSS property is used to make text bold?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which CSS property is used to make text bold?
quiz.explanation: font-weight controls the thickness of text; bold or 700 are common values.

quiz.question: Which of the following is a CSS preprocessor?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which of the following is a CSS preprocessor?
quiz.explanation: Sass is a CSS preprocessor; its source must be compiled to CSS for browsers.

quiz.question: Which CSS property is used to add shadow to text?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which CSS property is used to add shadow to text?
quiz.explanation: text-shadow adds shadow to text. box-shadow applies to the element box.

quiz.question: Which CSS property controls the visibility of an element?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which CSS property controls the visibility of an element?
quiz.explanation: visibility:hidden hides the element while preserving its layout space. display:none removes the layout box.

quiz.question: Which CSS property is used to create space around elements?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which CSS property is used to create space around elements?
quiz.explanation: Margin is the space outside the border; padding is the space between content and border.

quiz.question: Which of the following CSS properties changes the text color?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which of the following CSS properties changes the text color?
quiz.explanation: color sets text colour; background-color sets the background.

quiz.question: Which dedicated CSS longhand property sets the background image?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which property is used to set the background image of an element?
quiz.explanation: background-image sets an image layer; background is the broader shorthand.

quiz.question: Which option is a ready-made framework often used to create responsive websites?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which of the following is used to make a website responsive?
quiz.explanation: Bootstrap provides ready-made responsive layout components. Plain CSS can also create responsive layouts.

quiz.question: Which CSS framework is known for its grid system?
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which CSS framework is known for its grid system?
quiz.explanation: These frameworks provide utilities or components for grid-based layouts.

quiz.question: Which class adds 16px left and right padding?
quiz.explanation: w3-container adds horizontal padding. It does not add the vertical margins provided by w3-panel.
quiz.source: Knobly revision based on imported lessons
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which class adds 16px left and right padding?

quiz.question: What does w3-panel add compared with a plain container?
quiz.explanation: w3-panel adds vertical margins as well as horizontal padding. Add w3-border explicitly when needed.
quiz.source: Knobly revision based on imported lessons
quiz.sourceQuestion: What does w3-panel add compared with a plain container?

quiz.question: Which class makes an image circular?
quiz.explanation: w3-circle applies a 50% border radius. A square image or square crop produces a circle.
quiz.source: Knobly revision based on imported lessons
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which class makes an image circular?

quiz.question: Which class gives table rows a hover highlight?
quiz.explanation: w3-hoverable highlights a row when the pointer is over it; w3-striped alternates row backgrounds.
quiz.source: Knobly revision based on imported lessons
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which class gives table rows a hover highlight?

quiz.question: Which class positions content in the centre of a display container?
quiz.explanation: Use w3-display-middle inside a w3-display-container. w3-center aligns text.
quiz.source: Knobly revision based on imported lessons
quiz.sourceQuestion: Which class positions content in the centre of a display container?

quiz.question: Does a styled W3.CSS button toggle a panel automatically?
quiz.explanation: CSS styles the button. JavaScript or a native HTML interaction must handle the toggle.
